claims.subject: site identity
claims.proposition: The instrumented control is the real property/planning subject at 41 Lennard Road, Bromley BR2 8LN, UPRN 100020404537.
claims.limitation: Address/UPRN/property-index convergence identifies the screening subject but does not prove every legal interest or boundary.

claims.subject: planning authority and target context
claims.proposition: The site is in the London Borough of Bromley and the controlled Bromley local-planning target composes beneath the current London strategic target.
claims.limitation: Authority selection does not establish compliance or planning likelihood.

claims.subject: indicative parcel geometry
claims.proposition: HMLR/Planning Data provides a controlled indicative title-index polygon with derived screening area 783.6969 m².
claims.limitation: The index polygon is not a determined legal or measured survey boundary.

claims.subject: verified Reference House placement
claims.proposition: DPL-T-CANDIDATE-004-01 is a verified unchanged 12.0 m × 10.8 m unmirrored Reference House placement contained by the admitted screening polygon.
claims.limitation: Candidate fit/conformance is not a planning design judgement or whole-site compatibility result.

claims.subject: screening terrain and candidate datum
claims.proposition: EA 1 m DTM indicates a 70.20–71.10 m ODN parcel terrain envelope and T3 authors a 70.70 m ODN SCREENING FFL.
claims.limitation: No measured topographic survey, threshold design, cut/fill design, retaining design or accessible-gradient proof exists.

claims.subject: physical street/access relationship
claims.proposition: Exact-site planning evidence identifies the south-west Lennard Road frontage, existing front-garden/front-door access and a dropped kerb directly in front of the site.
claims.limitation: Physical screening evidence does not prove highway adoption extent, private access rights, construction access, detailed route levels or policy acceptability.

claims.limitation: The ~0.640 m title-index clearance cannot be promoted into a legal setback or construction tolerance.

claims.proposition: The verified Reference House source establishes two principal storeys, but candidate-specific policy-defined GIA, bedspace count, built-in storage, qualifying 2.5 m height area, qualifying private outdoor-space geometry and planning M4 assignment are not admitted as T5 proposal facts.
claims.limitation: Applicant-proposal attributes for 26/02618/FPA are not silently transferred to the different unchanged Reference House candidate.

claims.subject: current application context

claims.limitation: The application is not the Reference House candidate and supplies no transferable planning permission, design approval or candidate fact unless separately justified.
